items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: But he loved jazz and we used to jam after the gigs.

ctx.x: He ended up moving to Miami and joining the Miami Sound Machine. He was the cat in New York. But he loved jazz and we used to jam after the gigs. It’s unbelievable. This guy could play [scats] unbelievable Latin. But get him to walk four? It was funny. He could not do it.
